Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with serious diarrhea for the past couple of days.
Chief_Complaint.source_text:
I've just been for the past couple of days. I've been having this serious diarrhoea and this really,
Giving me trouble.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diarrhea began three days ago.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: It was three days ago.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Stool was initially watery and is now very loose.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: It's, it's, it's very loose but it started as being very watery.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: At least four bowel movements occurred today.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Today alone, I've been at least four time.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports feeling feverish with a high temperature.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Yes, I've been running a serious temperature. I'm literally boiling.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Temperature has not been measured with a thermometer.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No, 'cause I've not got one but like, to the touch, I'm, like, literally roasting.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Persistent vomiting with inability to keep down solids or liquids, including water and tea.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Yes, I've been throwing up. I can't keep to, uh, I can't seem to be able to keep anything in me. Not even water, not even my tea, not even any liquid stuff. I've just been throwing up everything.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Last vomited about two hours ago after attempting breakfast.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I was sick just after trying, uh, trying to have breakfast this morning, so maybe about two hours ago.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Urinating without difficulty.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Yeah, I've been, I've been, yeah, urinating OK.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Urine color has not been observed.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: To be honest, I have a look so I really couldn't say.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Last passed urine about one hour ago.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: And when did you last pass urine, do you think?
Patient: an hour ago.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies blood in stool or urine.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No blood.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Baseline bowel habit is one formed bowel movement daily in the morning.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Ah, ah, my, my bowels is normally fine. I would normally go to the toilet every day. You know, in the morning, just once, yeah, and that's fine.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies usual episodes of diarrhea or constipation.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: Any episodes of diarrhoea or constipation normally?
Patient: No.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports contact with her brother who has had similar symptoms for the past few days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: my, um my brother, um, has actually been having similar symptoms, um, for the past, um, few days as well

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Confirms direct contact with symptomatic brother.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: So you've been in contact with him, have you?
Patient: Yes.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports that many people at her brother's school have similar illness.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: and he does say like everyone in school's got this

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies rash.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No, no rash, no, nothing that, um.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Abdominal pain is centered around the navel and is very tender to touch.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it's kind of like towards my navel area, like I can't touch my navel area. It's just so sore. And it gets, yeah, it's almost like the center of my navel.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Abdominal pain is intermittent and associated with an urge to defecate.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Yes, it does come. When it comes, I feel this strong urge to go to the, to the loo, and then and sort of like comes again, it comes and.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has taken oral rehydration salts (salt-sugar mix).
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: The ORS, the, the salt sugar ORS, um, um, mix, the salt sugar mix.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has taken oral rehydration salts three times daily for the past two days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I've taken that, I've taken that, like, um, three times a day for the past two days.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Symptoms are not improving and vomiting may be preventing ORS effectiveness.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I, I, I they're not getting any better, 'cause like I said, I've been, I've been vomiting literally everything I take, so, so I doubt that even that had, had the chance to work.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies recent travel abroad.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: Have you been abroad anywhere?
Patient: No,

Past_Medical_History.content: No prior history of abdominal pain.

Past_Medical_History.source_text: Obviously I get the odd, um, you know, menstrual cramps and all that but, you know, that's, you know, that comes and goes.

Medications.source_text: I, I take my, my vitamins, vitamin D, every day.

Medications.content: Uses ibuprofen as needed for menstrual cramps.
Medications.source_text: for my menstrual cramps, when they come, maybe I might take a, a, an ibuprofen just to ease the pain

Social_and_Family_History.content: Drinks alcohol occasionally (a pint from time to time).
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: but, you know, I have a pint from time to time.
No. Like I said, I only take, um, vitamins.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Last menstrual period was two weeks ago.

Social_and_Family_History.source_text:
Doctor: Are you on any contraception?
Patient: No.

Doctor: Are you having regular sexual intercourse?
Patient: No.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Worked from home today due to illness.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I'm working from home today because I can't, I can't be out for work.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Lives with her brother and mother.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I live with my brother and my mum.

Assessment.content: Clinical impression is infectious gastroenteritis, usually viral.
Assessment.source_text: it sounds like it might be some, an infectious gastroenteritis that you've got, which is usually caused by a virus.
But, it can be from something you've eaten, as well.

Assessment.content: There is concern for dehydration due to inability to keep fluids down; hydration should be checked.
Assessment.source_text: we should also check that you're not getting dehydrated, because if you're, if you're not keeping fluid down, then you can get dehydrated.

Assessment.content: Passing urine an hour ago indicates hydration is at least sufficient to produce urine.
Assessment.source_text: It's a positive sign that you passed urine an hour ago. So, you're obviously still, um, hydrated enough to pass urine.

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange an urgent clinic appointment to assess hydration status.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: we can make you an urgent appointment, um, and then you can, you can get the sample sent off and we can check your hydration.

Plan_of_Care.content: Send a stool sample to check for bacterial infection requiring specific treatment.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I think it's probably important to get a sample of the stool, so we can make sure that you haven't got a nasty bacterial infection which needs specific treatment.

Plan_of_Care.content: Continue oral rehydration salts in very small, frequent sips.
Plan_of_Care.source_text:
you need to carry on with your rehydration salts, and just have very small amounts.
Just tiny sips constantly, to so that your stomach doesn't get overfilled and, and you vomit, so just tiny, tiny sips but just keep going with it.

Plan_of_Care.content: Consume simple foods such as toast or biscuits if eating.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: and just have very simple food, if you're gonna have anything, like toast or biscuit or something really light like that.

Plan_of_Care.content: Avoid fruit, vegetables, and milk while symptomatic.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Avoid, um, fruit, vegetables, uh, milk, anything like that, which might just make it worse.

Follow_up_Information.content: If feeling more unwell, seek urgent assessment at A&E.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: but if, in the meantime, you're feeling more unwell, then we would get you seen urgently in A and E.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient may call the clinic back in the meantime if needed.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: So you can call us back in the meantime.
